hook: Andreas Blattmann carried out his early generative AI research in the CompVis group at LMU Munich, where he co-authored High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models in 2021, the paper that introduced the latent diffusion technique underlying Stable Diffusion. He went on to work as a researcher at NVIDIA and then at Stability AI, contributing to image and video generation systems that led to Stable Video Diffusion. In 2024 he co-founded Black Forest Labs alongside fellow former Stability AI and CompVis researchers Robin Rombach, Patrick Esser, and Dominik Lorenz, building the company from labs in Freiburg and San Francisco. Black Forest Labs released the FLUX family of text to image models, which quickly became a widely adopted open and commercial foundation for image generation, and Blattmann was named to Capital Magazin's Top 40 Under 40 in Germany in 2024.
